items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload dangerous file types, leading to arbitrary code execution. It has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog due to active exploitation.

items.title: Two Critical Security Holes in PHP Affecting Magento and Other E-commerce Platforms
items.summary: Two critical security vulnerabilities were disclosed in PHP, the underlying software for Magento, allowing for potential remote code execution. Cloudflare observed initial exploitation attempts before updates were released.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through template engine injection. Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153, but a manual patch is required, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Arbitrary Code Execution in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: A critical vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could result in arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: Another critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical (CVSS 10.0) zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote code execution via improper neutralization of special elements in a template engine. It was actively exploited in the wild before a hotfix was released.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution, and Adobe is aware of its exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: Another high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Privilege Escalation and Remote Code Execution
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and escalate privileges. Indications of active exploitation emerged shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored XSS vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
